hashes: Image SHA256 normalizes CRLF to LF; audio SHA256 identifies the exact binary WAV bytes used for recognition.
visual_method: Every actual SVG rendered on a labeled topic contact sheet and visually inspected. Two ambiguous subjects were revised, then inspected at 320px and 64px by two reviewers. Unchanged images were compared to the baseline with line endings normalized.
audio_method: Independent offline Whisper base.en recognition of actual WAV speech; no initial prompt, no expected-word grammar, no text context; English transcription on CPU. Each batch emitted exactly ten nonempty noun segments, matched to input ordinal. Recognition timestamps are approximate and are retained alongside exact input boundaries.
audio_preprocessing: Original mono PCM16 WAV speech, resampled from 22050 to 16000 Hz with Python stdlib audioop; grouped in source order, 10 nouns per batch, separated by 600 ms zero PCM; no spoken labels or text hints added.

audio_provenance.model_sha256_verified_against: Hugging Face ggerganov/whisper.cpp repository LFS oid

revised_recording.method: Natural short picture-naming phrase A kite.; same Jenny friendly -8% profile. speechMarkup('kite') now preserves this utterance. No IPA, spelling, repetition, changed voice, or changed style in final candidate.
revised_recording.batch_mapping: Original batch09 source order. Article and noun occupy adjacent tokens a + kite for the second catalog entry; no positional one-token-per-noun assumption is made.

audio_limits: Automatic acoustic recognition supports the labels but is not human listening or a pronunciation study. SAPI alone matched only 37 of the 140 originals and was not used to declare other recordings incorrect. Sun/son cannot be distinguished by their sound. Kite was clarified after both recognizers produced tight; this does not establish that the original recording was definitely wrong.
scope_limit: Original catalog only. Actual Unity acquisition, CLI import and deployed imported-art verification remain pending.
